description: Reads the experiments from ~/.suunto-mcp/experiments.json: for each one its status ('upcoming', 'running', 'finished' (past its last day) or 'stopped'), the outcome metric, the dates, and TODAY's assignment: { date, arm ('intervention' | 'control' | 'washout' | 'none', or null before the start / after the end), instruction (the text to follow today), followed (what was logged, or null) }, progress (days elapsed, planned intervention and control days) and adherence (trial days so far, how many are logged, followed, not followed, not logged, in total and per arm). With `id`, `selected` is the whole experiment: hypothesis, analysis plan, seed, the full schedule and the day log. Local file only: never contacts Suunto, needs no credentials, writes nothing. A damaged or other-version file is an error naming it. Output: { today, experiments: [summary], selected, note }. Read-only.

id.description: An experiment id, e.g. 'e1', to get its full schedule and log in `selected`.

name: get_experiment
title: Get experiments: today's assignment, progress, adherence
